in_hebrew.name: Early
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Early הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek word 'hemera', meaning 'day'. Early signifies the start of something, the first. In a spiritual context, it can represent being the first to believe, the first to act on faith.
